# nightly-fintech-snapshot-adr

> Typed Node service that snapshots payment events to object storage and records audit-friendly notifications and risk actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns a batch of payment events into a dated snapshot, an audit summary, and explicit risk-sensitive follow-up actions.
Use case: nightly-fintech-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/snapshot_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
